demands.basis: Hardest supported contact change; grip, reach, visible foot precision, body extension and incline proxies

incline.basis: Used handholds; missing or non-finite local angles use wall setup

estimate.basis: Unvalidated movement-demand proxies and bounded easier-beta search; not a calibrated V-grade

personal.scale: Personal effort equivalent only; not a conventional V-grade
personal.model: Height-relative hand reach and compact hand/foot spacing; modest unvalidated adjustment

limitations: Wall scale uses the app default assumed 4 m height and image-edge guides.
Wall angles and route grade are provisional estimates.
Holds without confident contours retain polygon:null and must be shown as dashed detector boxes.
